_comment: Copy to docs-sync/config.json and edit. Drives scripts/collect-doc-changes.mjs, scripts/extract-symbols.mjs, and the /update-docs command. The live config.json is gitignored.
_branches_comment: Empty = update docs on every branch push. Restrict with e.g. ['main', 'staging'].

docs._comment: output_dir: root of the living-docs folder. changelog: the append-only file.

external_docs._comment_1: For projects whose docs live OUTSIDE the repo. On first interactive /update-docs run, Claude asks if docs live elsewhere and records the link here.

generation._comment: use_ast: allow ast-grep-based symbol extraction for Exports tables.

llm_narration._comment: When true, /update-docs writes the prose sections (what the file does, Notes). When false, only Exports and Dependencies tables are generated.
